#Landlord.Face.Normal
Landlord: Did you meet my daughter? What did she tell you? Was she busy with her college and didn’t have time for her poor father? That’s only reasonable, right? 
You: Not exactly. 
You: She dropped out of college a long time ago.
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
Landlord: Huh? 
You: She called you a smelly old man.
Landlord: Ha?
You: She said that you are disgusting, both on the outside and on the inside.
Landlord: T-That’s gotta be some kind of m-mistake. A-Are you sure you got the right person? 
You: Yes.
Landlord: …
You: I understand that it might be hard for you to accept, but this is the truth. Sorry.
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
Landlord: I think that…{{wi}} deep inside, I knew about it. {{wi}}I knew about it for a long time, but I didn’t want to admit it…
Landlord: Thank you for doing this for me… 
Landlord: You can pack your things. We will be leaving whenever you want. 
Landlord: I will go now. I don’t feel so well…
